notes: Counts are search records, not a count of purchasable upgrades.
Named registries and parallel name/description/effect maps are grouped; other gameplay strings remain separate.
All nonempty strings in the selected gameplay translation roots are included, including labels and validation help.
Untranslated visible index.html text and tooltips supplement the translations.
Runtime TypeScript expressions, player-state values, computed costs, generated DOM and platform-specific text are not evaluated.
Angle brackets ⟨value⟩ mark unresolved game interpolation parameters; no game save is loaded.
UI-only translation roots (account, save/import, settings, layout, platform, feedback and announcements) are excluded explicitly.

entries.name: CLEANSE THE CORRUPTION
entries.text:
CLEANSE THE CORRUPTION

Free this world of sin.

Set Corruption to level 0 for this Ascension and the next. Does not reset your current Ascension.

Set the next Ascension to level ⟨level⟩, your highest cleared level. This Ascension also drops to that level if it is higher. Does not reset your current Ascension.

Press Cleanse, then Confirm, to go through with it.

Note: if you need to do this, you may have bitten off more than you can chew.

entries.name: How many cubes open
entries.text:
How many cubes would you like to open? You have ⟨x⟩! 
You can input a percentage of cubes to open, for example: "50%" or "100%". 
You can start the input with "-" (put in a negative value) to put in a value, that will be saved, which means you open all cubes except the specified number (also works with %).

entries.name: Construction stats · Extra info
entries.text:
Every Coin, Crystal, Mythos and Particle Building has a base Softcap of 1000 owned, which is multiplied by Construction. The quadratic scaling thresholds of Accelerators and Multipliers, and the cost scaling delay of Accelerator Boosts, are multiplied by √Construction as well. 
 Each Building costs a fixed multiple more than the last until you own as many as its Softcap. Past that, the price exponent grows quadratically. 
 Past the Softcap, the price exponent gains an extra (Owned - Softcap)² / Softcap, so more Construction both delays the quadratic scaling and makes it grow more slowly. 
 Challenges 4 and 10 divide Coin and Crystal Building Construction by 2, and Challenge 8 divides Coin, Crystal and Mythos Building Construction by 5 (Challenge 8 takes priority). 
 The 'Rocky Foundations' Corruption divides Construction for everything.
